judgment: Defensible as a new preregistered conditional CPU-rate-profile comparison for the literal bounded recheck in KICADROUTE-73 criterion5. The issue does not mandate12 unconstrained CPUs. It can support that declared condition only if actual resource parity and all original full-CLI/native/1.10 gates pass. It cannot convert failed unrestricted comparisons into passes or establish general full12CPU performance. Verification is not self-acceptance.
original_requirement: Existing simple-board completion and the owner's 10 percent runtime/memory limits are rechecked for this semantic engine change.

new_context.authority: Owner already authorizes development/native verification. Root demonstrated an own-process normal-priority transient user scope withCPUQuota=200% and /usr/bin/true exit0. No unrelated workload/global or privileged resource change is proposed.
new_context.source: Referencef0c09ac; candidatef0f73da and prepared603 remain frozen.
new_context.affinity: Full0–11 unchanged for both sides. CPUQuota=200% means maximum aggregate CPU time equivalent to2logical CPUs, not a reservation of2physical cores.
new_context.scope: Entire comparison driver plus its CLI/native descendants must be in the verified quota scope; Unix session changes do not by themselves escape a cgroup. All baseline/candidate samples run sequentially under identical scope settings and ancestors.
new_context.period: Explicitly preregister and verify quota period, preferably unchanged systemd default100ms. Record cpu.max.burst.200% at100ms is normally200000/100000; do not assume it without reading actual cpu.max. Bursty parallel native work can interact with period throttling.
new_context.ancestor_observation: Leaf cpu.stat bandwidth-throttling counters do not include all ancestor-induced throttling. Record ancestor limits and counters as well; use cpu.stat.local if available, without assuming every supported kernel exposes it.

calibration_recommendation.work: Exactly3trials for the200% profile, each four concurrent child processes consuming3process-CPU-seconds apiece. Total intended child work12CPU-seconds. Parent/launch overhead and actual cgroup CPU usage must also be recorded.
prespecify_before_any_native_result: All3trials complete successfully, each child reports its actual CPU work and no process/descendant escapes the intended scope.
For a chosen profile, every trial wall is no more than1.10times its declared ideal:6.6s at200%,13.2s at100%. Verify actual delivered cgroupCPU/elapsed and childCPU totals as well, not elapsed alone.

For repeatability, require max(trialwall)/min(trialwall)<=1.10 across all3trials. A materially faster-than-quota result requires investigating actual quota/burst/CPU counters; it must not be treated as proof of reserved service.

Read actual quota/period/burst/weight/affinity/ancestor constraints and CPU usage/throttle counters for every trial. Snapshot global host PSI separately; pressure/throttling can be caused by the test itself.
calibration_recommendation.selection: If every200%calibration criterion passes, choose200%and do not explore alternatives. Otherwise run exactly3trials at100%with the same preregistered criteria, before any router result. If100%also fails, stop resource-inconclusive. No additional quota, priority, best-trial selection or repeated calibration batches.
calibration_recommendation.limitation: A CPU-bound calibration measures currently attainable aggregate service, not future resource availability or native KiCad latency. It does not reserve service, model IO/memory stalls, prove stable native parallel scheduling or guarantee any route comparison passes.

benchmark_requirements: Preregister exactly one new four-board matrix with5measured repetitions and separate warmups per side, frozen comparison functions and new output namespace. All4outcomes remain, even after a failed board verdict.

Same actual host/toolchain/input/rules and quota/period/burst/ancestor/affinity/normal-priority configuration for baseline and candidate. Detect changed resource configuration, and retain it explicitly rather than claiming parity.

Keep original native budgets/stall logic, full public-CLI GNU-time wall measurement, copper/migration-equivalence policy, all warmup/measured process/routing/validation/preservation/pair/input/stop checks, and all three1.10median gates.
Include quota throttling, native refill/DRC and waiting in full-CLI wall time. Do not substitute CPU time, deduct quota delay, enlarge budgets or discard/retry a completed sample.

Capture /proc/self/cgroup, resolved cgroup mount/membership and all relevant ancestor cpu.max/weight/cpuset settings, cpu.max.burst when present, cgroupcpu.stat before/after, actual affinity and global /proc/pressure/{cpu,io,memory} with timestamps. Root cgroup may legitimately omit cpu.max; distinguish root omission from an unverified nonroot quota.
Record actual scope placement of observed descendants, or retained inheritance/configuration evidence sufficient to show scope coverage. starts_new_session alone is not a cgroup boundary.

Quota exhaustion and nr_throttled increases are expected under this profile; they are diagnostic, not reasons to exclude samples. After-pressure likewise does not invalidate or retry a completed attempt.
Maintain all failed historical unrestricted/env-reuse comparisons and the expired zero-sample quiet-admission experiment as distinct history. Do not mutate the frozen quiet harness/protocol.
If the new matrix fails any original gate, resource/runtime acceptance remains unmet. A pass is bounded to this rate profile and finite workload/toolchain sample.
non_goals: No claim that quota caps guarantee scheduling service
No priority elevation or sibling/global workload changes
No source change, native job or scope creation performed by this review
No final doctrine reassembly before qualifying terminal evidence

primary_sources.supports: CPUQuota is a maximum relative to one CPU; default quota period100ms; actual weight/hierarchy can matter.
CPU controller hierarchy and cpu.max/cpu.stat semantics; forked descendants inherit cgroup membership and ancestor limits constrain descendants.
